title: Practice regex rewriting
description: This starter program holds three rewrite tasks and checks a completed rule against its target result.

steps.description: TASKS contains a description, an unfinished rule, an input string, and the result each rewrite should produce. Each rule slot starts as None.
The loop prints each task. An unfinished rule prints a marker and skips the substitution.

steps.question: Does re.sub run while a task's rule is None?
steps.answer: It does not run because continue moves directly to the next task.

steps.description: Once a rule exists, the code separates its pattern and replacement, applies re.sub, and compares the result with want.
The initial run reaches the unfinished-rule branch for the first task.
